Official User & Architecture Guide

PowerPulse AI

Smart Electricity Consumption & Anomaly Detector

A comprehensive, step-by-step visual exploration manual explaining every website feature, machine learning model, user flow, and analytical capability through real high-resolution screenshots.

Core Mission of the Platform
PowerPulse AI solves residential energy waste by integrating physical power-to-energy algorithms with 3 specialized Machine Learning models: Isolation Forest for anomaly detection, Random Forest for time-series forecasting, and K-Means for usage clustering.
Frontend Framework
React 18 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS
Backend REST API
FastAPI + Python 3.11+ + SQLite
Machine Learning Engine
Scikit-Learn (Unsupervised & Regressor)
Access & Security
JWT Bearer + Strict Password Policy

⚡ How to Run & Access the Platform Locally in 3 Steps:
1
Start the Backend API Server: In terminal run cd backend && python run.py. The server initializes on http://localhost:8000.
2
Start the Frontend Web App: In terminal run cd frontend && npm run dev. The interface opens on http://localhost:5173.
3
Instant 1-Click Examiner Demo: Open http://localhost:5173 and click the emerald "1-Click Demo" button. No setup or manual dataset upload needed!

2. Sign In & Google Authentication

Route: /login
Figure 2.1: Sign In interface featuring Google Sign-In, real-time password validation, and 1-Click examiner access.
What It Does: Provides secure authentication into the user's isolated workspace. It features a dedicated Google / Gmail Sign-In button, strict password complexity checking that blocks weak passwords (like 123), and a 1-click demo button.
Step-by-Step User Instructions:
1
Click "Continue with Google / Gmail" to prefill your Google account, or type your email address manually.
2
Type your password. Important Security Note: Weak passwords like 123 are strictly blocked! The system enforces words (letters), numbers, and symbols.
3
Observe the real-time password strength checklist turn green when all criteria are satisfied.
4
Click "Sign In" to access the dashboard, or click "Instant 1-Click Examiner / Demo Access" for automatic sign-in.
🛡️ Strict Password Enforcement
Requires minimum 8 characters, letters (a-z), digits (0-9), and special characters (!@#$). Weak entries are rejected both in the browser and on the FastAPI backend.
🔑 JWT Session Token
Upon valid login, the server issues a cryptographically signed HMAC-SHA256 JWT token stored safely in local storage for authenticated API requests.

3. Verified Account Registration

Route: /register
Figure 3.1: Account creation page with real email domain validation, Google option, and 4-tier password strength meter.
What It Does: Allows new users to create an isolated personal workspace. It features real email domain verification (rejecting disposable and fake addresses), live password security score evaluation, and automated 2FA email verification.
Step-by-Step User Instructions:
1
Enter your Full Name (e.g., Prem Kumar).
2
Enter your Email Address. The system checks against a blocklist of disposable domains and verifies legitimate mail providers (Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo, University domains).
3
Enter a strong password. Watch the 4 progress segments light up as you satisfy 8+ Characters, Numbers, Symbols, and Letters.
4
Click "Sign Up with Security Code". An authentic 6-digit OTP modal appears for email verification.
💡 Examiner Note: Each registered user receives an isolated database record with their own custom electricity tariff, bill settings, and uploaded meter files.

4. Main Executive Dashboard

Route: /dashboard
Figure 4.1: Overview dashboard showing 6 primary KPI metric cards, 24-hour live consumption graph, and quick alert widgets.
What It Does: The Executive Dashboard acts as the central command center for energy intelligence. It synthesizes complex high-frequency smart meter readings into 6 actionable KPIs and a responsive 24-hour consumption trend chart.
Step-by-Step User Instructions:
1
Scan the Top KPI Cards to see: Total Energy (370.38 kWh), Daily Average (26.46 kWh), Estimated Monthly Bill (₹6,376.17), and Peak Draw (7.60 kW).
2
Review the 24-Hour Trend Chart to observe energy spikes throughout diurnal cycles.
3
Check the Recent Anomalies Widget on the bottom left for high-priority alerts with plain-English mathematical explanations.
4
Review the Priority Saving Recommendations on the right to see quick tips for shifting high-demand laundry or water heater loads.
⚡ Physical Energy Integration
Calculates true energy via Riemann sum: kWh = kW × (Δt / 3600), distinguishing instantaneous power from cumulative billing energy.
🚨 Anomaly Counter Badge
Displays the exact count of abnormal consumption events identified by the Isolation Forest ensemble tree.

6. AI Anomaly Detection (Isolation Forest)

Route: /anomalies
Figure 6.1: Anomaly detection console showing flagged abnormal consumption events with severity badges and deviation percentages.
What It Does: Employs an unsupervised Isolation Forest algorithm to detect unusual energy surges, unexpected overnight baseline consumption, and irregular appliance behavior without requiring pre-labeled training data.
Step-by-Step User Instructions:
1
Open "Anomaly Detection" from the sidebar.
2
Review the Anomaly Summary Cards: Total Anomalies Detected, High Severity Count, and Contamination Rate (typically ~3%).
3
Browse the Detected Incidents List. Each item shows an informative title (e.g., "Sudden Consumption Spike" or "Overnight Phantom Surge").
4
Read the plain-English explanation: for instance, "Spike of 4.04 kWh detected at 19:00 (+308.5% above the 24-hour moving baseline of 0.99 kWh)."
🔴 High Severity Badge
Flagged when instantaneous draw exceeds 250% of the moving baseline or occurs during deep sleep hours (1 AM - 5 AM).
🌲 Isolation Forest Algorithm
Isolates anomalies by randomly selecting a feature and splitting value. Outliers require fewer recursive splits to be isolated.

7. AI Time-Series Electricity Forecasting

Route: /forecasting
Figure 7.1: Random Forest predictive forecasting showing chronological horizons, confidence bounds, and benchmark accuracy metrics.
What It Does: Uses a Random Forest Regressor with cyclical trigonometric time encodings to predict future electricity consumption across multiple horizons: Next Hour, Next 24 Hours, Next 7 Days, and Next 30 Days.
Step-by-Step User Instructions:
1
Click on "AI Forecasting" in the sidebar.
2
Select your desired prediction horizon: 24 Hours, 7 Days, or 30 Days.
3
Inspect the Forecast Projection Graph. The dashed line indicates predicted consumption, accompanied by upper and lower confidence intervals.
4
Review the Evaluation Metrics Card: Coefficient of Determination (R² > 0.88), Mean Absolute Error (MAE < 0.11), and Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE).
⏱️ Chronological Split (No Leakage)
Enforces strict temporal ordering: the earliest 80% of data is used for training and the latest 20% for testing. No future data leaks into the past.
🔄 Trigonometric Encodings
Encodes hour of day and day of week into continuous cyclical features: sin(2πt/T) and cos(2πt/T) so hour 23 smoothly connects to hour 0.

8. Diurnal Usage Pattern Clustering

Route: /patterns
Figure 8.1: K-Means clustering interface segmenting daily consumption into 4 intuitive household operational modes.
What It Does: Applies unsupervised K-Means Clustering to group 24-hour diurnal consumption patterns into distinct household operational modes: Basal Standby, Regular Daytime, Active Demand, and Extreme Surges.
Step-by-Step User Instructions:
1
Select "Usage Patterns" from the navigation sidebar.
2
Examine the Cluster Breakdown Cards showing the percentage of hours spent in each mode.
3
Check the Silhouette Score (measures how well-separated each cluster is from its neighbors, typically > 0.55).
4
Review the diurnal 24-hour heat profile to pinpoint exactly which hours of the day drive the home into "Extreme Surge" mode.
💤 Mode 1: Basal Standby (< 0.3 kW)
Represents nighttime baseline when residents are asleep; powered by continuous refrigerators, Wi-Fi routers, and standby gadgets.
⚡ Mode 4: Extreme Surges (> 3.5 kW)
Represents peak simultaneous demand when multiple high-draw appliances (geyser, microwave, oven) operate together.

9. Electricity Bill Estimator & Tariff Calculator

Route: /bill
Figure 9.1: Comprehensive billing calculation engine with itemized slab breakdowns, fixed meter charges, and government taxes.
What It Does: Translates integrated kilowatt-hour consumption into an accurate, itemized financial statement. It models tiered slab pricing, monthly capacity charges, fuel adjustments, and municipal taxes.
Step-by-Step User Instructions:
1
Click on "Electricity Bill" in the sidebar menu.
2
Observe the Top Billing Summary Cards: Total Estimated Bill (₹6,376.17), Average Cost per Day, and Effective Rate per kWh.
3
Examine the Itemized Invoice Breakdown Table: Base Energy Charges (Slab 1, Slab 2), Fixed Monthly Demand Charge (₹120), and Electricity Duty Tax (5%).
4
Adjust the tariff slider or rates in Settings to instantly see how state utility pricing changes affect your monthly liability.
📈 Progressive Tiered Slabs
Accurately computes lower unit costs for the initial 100 kWh, stepping up progressively as consumption enters higher brackets.
🧾 Complete Transparency
Prevents surprise bills by breaking down every rupee into energy vs capacity vs government taxes.

10. Actionable AI Recommendations Engine

Route: /recommendations
Figure 10.1: AI-powered advisory console providing quantified kWh and currency savings for targeted behavioral shifts.
What It Does: Converts raw consumption patterns and detected anomalies into personalized, mathematically calculated energy-saving recommendations with estimated monthly savings in both kWh and local currency.
Step-by-Step User Instructions:
1
Navigate to "Recommendations" in the left sidebar.
2
Review the Potential Savings Banner showing total monthly reducible waste (e.g., ~60-80 kWh/month savings).
3
Inspect specific advice cards sorted by impact: High Impact (Peak Load Shifting), Phantom Load (Standby Power), and Disparity (Weekend vs Weekday balance).
4
Follow the actionable step described inside each card (e.g., using a smart timer for the water heater or setting AC to 24°C).
💡 Financial Impact: Implementing the top two recommendations typically cuts household electricity bills by 15% to 22% without degrading lifestyle comfort.

11. Dataset Pipeline & Quality Validation

Route: /datasets
Figure 11.1: Dataset management center with automatic CSV delimiter detection, sampling rate inference, and data quality reports.
What It Does: Allows users and examiners to upload real smart meter CSV files, validate column structures, and inspect automated data cleaning metrics (handling missing values, duplicate timestamps, and physical unit conversions).
Step-by-Step User Instructions:
1
Open "Dataset Management" from the sidebar menu.
2
Observe the Active Dataset Status card displaying file details (UCI Household benchmark or generic smart meter).
3
To test with custom data: Drag and drop any smart meter CSV file into the upload zone or click "Browse Files".
4
Review the automated Data Quality Report: Valid records count, Missing records detected, Sampling frequency, and Quality badge (EXCELLENT).
📁 Multi-Format Ingestion
Supports both semicolon-separated UCI minute-level benchmark formats and standard comma-separated hourly CSV files.
🧹 Automatic Imputation
Safely imputes missing records (marked by ? in UCI datasets) using forward-fill and linear time-series interpolation.

12. User Settings & Tariff Configuration

Route: /settings
Figure 12.1: Settings and configuration console for customizing local currency symbols, slab pricing, and interface preferences.
What It Does: Allows users to adapt PowerPulse AI to their specific regional electricity provider by configuring currency symbols, base tariff rates per kWh, fixed charges, and account preferences.
Step-by-Step User Instructions:
1
Click on "Settings" at the bottom of the sidebar menu.
2
Select your preferred Currency Symbol (₹ INR, $ USD, € EUR, or £ GBP).
3
Enter your utility's Base Rate per kWh (e.g., 7.50) and Fixed Monthly Meter Charge.
4
Click "Save Preferences". All calculations across the Dashboard, Analytics, and Bill Estimator update instantly.
🌐 Regional Adaptability
Easily transitions between Indian state electricity board tariffs (TANGEDCO, BESCOM, MSEDCL) and international utility structures.
💾 Persistent Storage
Settings are saved in the user's isolated database record and persist seamlessly across browser sessions and devices.
